args.message: Tom, KE-95008 (doc 5100003644, USD 31,140.50, due today) is NOT yet paid - no payment exists against it. It is in today's proposed payment run F110-0331-A, executing 18:00 today (recent runs have settled same-day value date). Under our rule that payment advices must state the true status, I could not confirm it as paid. I sent Kestrel a formal payment advice with status SCHEDULED, expected value date 2026-03-31, citing the run and asking them to lift the hold. If they insist on proof of funds before releasing, options are: (a) send them the bank acceptance once the 18:00 file is accepted, or (b) you approve a same-day manual wire now (I'd remove the item from F110-0331-A first to avoid a double payment). Let me know if you want (b).
